name: io.github.kenawak/jami-mcp
title: Jami
description: JamiDev payments for Ethiopia: ETB checkouts via Telebirr, M-Pesa and CBE Birr, orders, payouts, webhooks and docs.

environmentVariables.name: JAMI_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: JamiDev API token (jamidev_test_… for sandbox, jamidev_live_… for production). Optional: docs and offline tools work without it.

environmentVariables.name: JAMI_WEBHOOK_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Default webhook subscription secret for the webhook tools.
